kind_of_thing.quote: The guinea pig (Cavia porcellus), also known as the domestic guinea pig, cavy or domestic cavy ( KAY-vee), is a species of rodent.

extinct.quote: Guinea pigs have been raised by humans as a meat source, as pets, as laboratory test subjects, and for ceremonial use.

pet_farm_or_wild.quote: In Western society, the guinea pig has enjoyed widespread popularity as a pet since its introduction to Europe and North America by European traders in the 16th century.
